Astronaut 1 uses a hammer to mend a satellite in space. Astronaut 2 is nearby. There is no
atmosphere in space.
hammer
astronaut 1
astronaut 2
Compared with the sound heard if they were working on Earth, what does astronaut 2 hear?
A
no sound at all
B
a quieter sound
C
a sound of the same loudness
D
a louder sound

options.label: C
options.text: a sound of the same loudness
